timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,340 KRW/USD (or lower)

WHY: The won is at a 14-month HIGH (strong), meaning the KRW/USD rate is at its LOWEST level in 14 months. Since a strong won makes converting to dollars cheaper, this is a favorable window for your monthly $2,000 purchase.

TIP: Consider converting now or soon before the won weakens further, since your fixed dollar obligation means you benefit most when the won is strong.
